claim.statement: Cognition's current GitHub integration documentation says an administrator can grant Devin all organization repositories or selected repositories and that the GitHub App requests read/write access for checks, commit statuses, contents, discussions, issues, pull requests, projects and workflows so Devin can push branches, open pull requests and participate in pull-request discussions.

limitations: Requested integration permissions do not prove installation, effective access, successful writes, review acceptance or merge authority.
unknowns: The installation owner, repository scope, branch protections, token permissions, pushed branches and pull-request outcomes are unknown.
